catalogue.m1l: pixels differing from the Figma render
catalogue.note: Read from the Figma file (page “old website”, frame “desktop”), class for class from the design context; the frame is 1600 wide and unscaled. Figma lays lines on whole pixels (28px at 160% is 45px, not 44.8) and so does this build. The handwritten note (“You can add more info but this button is all you need.”) is set in Journal, a face that cannot be served, so it ships as Figma’s own SVG export of that text node, outlined. The phone renders are the file’s images at 2x, WebP. The step numbers 2 and 3 are Montserrat ExtraLight (200) and “Alex Heaton, Designer” is Bold Italic: screen.html loads both, but the embed and this page load Montserrat 400–800 and italic 400 only, so here they draw in the nearest weight. What remains in the diff is glyph edges, resampled photo edges, and a 1px baseline on the 28px body copy, where Chrome and Figma round half-leading differently.
